slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly intelligent

country of the week

pick one country every week and learn its history, one dish and one word in its language. by the end of the year you can talk to almost anyone about where they're from.

museum audio guides

once a month, go to a museum and listen to the full audio guide for just 3 rooms. going slowly through a few things teaches you more than rushing through everything.

news from elsewhere

read one news story a day from a country you've never been to. you start seeing your own world from the outside, which is where real understanding begins.

daily masterpiece

spend 5 minutes a day on one famous painting, sculpture or building and the story behind it. knowing why something is beautiful makes you start seeing beauty everywhere.
slides.texte_sophia:
daily masterpiece

spend 5 minutes a day on one famous painting or building and the story behind it. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it a daily habit, and you start seeing beauty everywhere.

slides.texte_overlay:
asking older people

once a week, ask someone over 70 how life used to be when they were young. one hour of real stories teaches you more history than a whole semester of dates.
